description: This file contains API functions for fetching project costs and cost history summaries, intended for frontend usage in a dashboard. It exports functions that make HTTP GET requests to specific API endpoints related to project cost data.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a project from the backend API, given a project ID. Returns project cost details including project ID, cost amount, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches and returns the total historical cost for a project, computed from granular delta updates, given a project ID.
